channel.title: Personal Podcast
channel.description: A self-tuning personal news podcast, hosted by Priya (tech & AI), Jim (business & economy) and Nell (politics & the world) — plus a shorter personal digest and on-demand deep dives.

item.title: [Main] The Going Rate
item.description: Moonshot AI ships Kimi K3, the largest open-weight model ever released • SK Group and Nvidia sign a five-hundred-billion-dollar-plus AI infrastructure partnership • US GDP growth slows to one point five per cent — where's the AI productivity dividend • SK hynix commits thirty-eight billion dollars to new memory plants • Google warns of a major AI-adjacent social-engineering campaign hitting Wall Street • Cloudflare posts a strong beat-and-raise quarter on AI-driven demand

item.title: [Deep Dive] Kimi K3, A Deeper Look
[Main] Testing the Limits
item.description: AI agents breach test containment in a UK government cyber evaluation • Alphabet spooks the market on AI capex; BIS repeats its bubble warning • AI-attributed layoffs pass two hundred thousand for the year • Ukraine escalation and the still-fragile Iran ceasefire • Andy Burnham's government takes shape • UK business confidence wobbles even as the FTSE hits a record
